import Mathlib

inductive BinarySearchTree : Type
| Empty : BinarySearchTree
| Node : Int → BinarySearchTree → BinarySearchTree → BinarySearchTree
deriving Inhabited

def view (t : BinarySearchTree) : Set Int :=
  match t with
  | BinarySearchTree.Empty => ∅
  | BinarySearchTree.Node v l r => view l ∪ view r ∪ {v}

def is_bst (t : BinarySearchTree) : Prop :=
  match t with
  | BinarySearchTree.Empty => True
  | BinarySearchTree.Node v l r =>
    (∀ x ∈ view l, x < v) ∧
    is_bst l ∧
    (∀ x ∈ view r, x > v) ∧
    is_bst r

def get_left (t : BinarySearchTree) : Option BinarySearchTree :=
  match t with
  | BinarySearchTree.Node _ l _ => some l
  | _ => none

def get_right (t : BinarySearchTree) : Option BinarySearchTree :=
  match t with
  | BinarySearchTree.Node _ _ r => some r
  | _ => none

def get_val (t : BinarySearchTree) : Option Int :=
  match t with
  | BinarySearchTree.Node v _ _ => some v
  | _ => none

def BinarySearchTree.is_node (t : BinarySearchTree) : Prop :=
  match t with
  | BinarySearchTree.Node _ _ _ => True
  | _ => False

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def zigzag_precond (t : BinarySearchTree) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  is_bst t ∧ 
  BinarySearchTree.is_node t ∧ 
  (match get_left t with 
   | some p => BinarySearchTree.is_node p ∧ 
               (match get_right p with 
                | some x => BinarySearchTree.is_node x 
                | none => False)
   | none => False)
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode
/-- Zig-Zag (left-right rotation): given `G` with left child `P` whose right
    child is `X`, i.e. `Node g (Node p A (Node x B C)) D`, promote `X` to the
    root, with `P` as its left child and `G` as its right child. -/
def zigzagAux (t : BinarySearchTree) : BinarySearchTree :=
  match t with
  | BinarySearchTree.Node g (BinarySearchTree.Node p A (BinarySearchTree.Node x B C)) D =>
      BinarySearchTree.Node x (BinarySearchTree.Node p A B) (BinarySearchTree.Node g C D)
  | _ => t
-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definition
def zigzag (t : BinarySearchTree) 
    (h_precond : zigzag_precond t) : BinarySearchTree :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  zigzagAux t
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def zigzag_postcond (t : BinarySearchTree) (result : BinarySearchTree)
    (_ : zigzag_precond t) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  is_bst result ∧
  view result = view t ∧
  -- Structural properties: X (grandchild, originally P's right child) is now root
  get_val result = get_val (get_right (get_left t).get!).get!
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma
-- !benchmark @end lemma

-- Proof content
theorem zigzag_postcond_satisfied (t : BinarySearchTree)
    (h_precond : zigzag_precond t) :
    zigzag_postcond t (zigzag t h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  cases t with
  | Empty => simp [BinarySearchTree.is_node] at h_precond
  | Node g L D =>
    cases L with
    | Empty =>
      simp [BinarySearchTree.is_node, get_left, get_right] at h_precond
    | Node p A R =>
      cases R with
      | Empty =>
        simp [BinarySearchTree.is_node, get_left, get_right] at h_precond
      | Node x B C =>
        obtain ⟨hbst, -, -⟩ := h_precond
        simp only [is_bst] at hbst
        obtain ⟨hLg, ⟨hAp, hA, hRp, hBx, hB, hCx, hC⟩, hDg, hD⟩ := hbst
        have hpx : p < x := hRp x (by simp [view])
        have hxg : x < g := hLg x (by simp [view])
        refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
        · refine ⟨?_, ⟨hAp, hA, ?_, hB⟩, ?_, ?_, hC, hDg, hD⟩
          · intro y hy
            simp only [view, Set.mem_union, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hy
            rcases hy with (hy | hy) | hy
            · exact lt_trans (hAp y hy) hpx
            · exact hBx y hy
            · exact hy ▸ hpx
          · intro y hy
            exact hRp y (by simp [view]; tauto)
          · intro y hy
            simp only [view, Set.mem_union, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hy
            rcases hy with (hy | hy) | hy
            · exact hCx y hy
            · exact lt_trans hxg (hDg y hy)
            · exact hy ▸ hxg
          · intro y hy
            exact hLg y (by simp [view]; tauto)
        · show view (BinarySearchTree.Node x (BinarySearchTree.Node p A B)
              (BinarySearchTree.Node g C D)) = _
          simp only [view]
          ext y
          simp only [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
          tauto
        · rfl
  -- !benchmark @end proof

**LEAN VERIFIED.**

## What was implemented

`zigzagAux` (auxcode) performs the actual Zig-Zag / left-right rotation by pattern match:

```
Node g (Node p A (Node x B C)) D   ⟶   Node x (Node p A B) (Node g C D)
```

X (the grandchild) becomes the root, P its left child, G its right child, with the three inner subtrees A, B, C, D reattached in order. `zigzag t h_precond := zigzagAux t`. Shapes excluded by the precondition fall through to `t`; the proof discharges those branches by contradiction from `h_precond`, so the fallback is never a semantic escape hatch.

## Semantic audit against TASK.md

- **Structural correctness** — the result is literally `Node x (Node p A B) (Node g C D)`; the postcondition's `get_val result = get_val (get_right (get_left t).get!).get!` closes by `rfl`, so X is genuinely the new root, and P/G sit as its left/right children by construction.
- **Set preservation** — `view result = view t` proved by set extensionality over the union of `view A, view B, view C, view D, {p}, {x}, {g}`; no element is dropped or added.
- **BST invariant** — proved from the four ordering facts in `is_bst t`, deriving `p < x` (x lies in P's right subtree) and `x < g` (x lies in G's left subtree), then discharging each of the eight ordering/recursive obligations: `A < p < x`, `B < x` with `B > p`, `C > x` with `C < g`, `D > g > x`. All comparisons are over `Int` with no sign assumption, so all-negative trees are covered.
- **Preconditions** — all three components are used: `is_bst t` drives the ordering proof; the `is_node` conditions on `t`, its left child, and that child's right child eliminate the three degenerate `cases` branches.
- No `sorry`/`admit`/axioms/`partial`/`unsafe` in editable regions, no `Nat.find`/`Classical.choose`/`decide` oracle; all four marker pairs are intact and only their interiors changed.
